'''Agents For Hire''' is the second of three releases of [[Virtual Block 8]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 14 September 2012.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 28 cards: 11 Dark Side and 17 Light Side.

== Discrepancies ==
* Printed as Devaronian Uncle; later released as [[Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026183836/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Lando's Luxury Yacht; later released as [[Lady Luck]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll" />
